description: Holds a signal down and lets it back to full level for a moment on each trigger, so accented hits stand out

params.text: Sets how far the signal drops between accents: fully anticlockwise it drops to four fifths, and past about nine tenths of the travel it passes through silence and comes back inverted
Fires an accent; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires an accent; the length of the gate makes no difference
The signal accented here; with nothing patched the module puts out silence

outputs.text: The input at the level the accent envelope allows, clipped at 5V

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
the accent envelope is fixed at 70ms and no control changes it
an accent never makes the signal louder than the input; the knob only lowers everything between accents, despite the manual saying it boosts the accented signal

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
